title: onychium japonicum var. lucidum
intro: Onychium japonicum var. lucidum, commonly known as Japanese Onychium, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Onychium japonicum var. lucidum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-asthmatic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites. The plant's health benefits are also thought to be due to its ability to reduce oxidative stress and modulate the immune system.
